Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Blue Ocean Waves Print Wall Art on Canvas, 36" x 24"
Colors: Multi
Materials: canvas
White foam swirls amid blue ocean waves lapping along the shoreline. This artful close-up of one of nature's wonders will bring a soothing touch of nature to your room. Printed on canvas that arrives ready to hang for a contemporary presentation. Contemporary print of classic nature scene Hand-stretched canvas on wood. Ready to hang with hardware included. 36" x 24" Made to order
